card: This PR begins the formal deprecation cycle for no-op watch-only options across wallet RPCs, including fundrawtransaction, walletcreatefundedpsbt, send, sendall, and simulaterawtransaction. Passing includeWatching, include_watching, or include_watchonly now fails with RPC_METHOD_DEPRECATED unless -deprecatedrpc=watchonly is set. The author notes these options have had no functional effect since commit 1337c72198a7d32935431d64e9e58c12f9003abc.
changed_since_previous: Diff inspection confirms the specific options (`includeWatching`, `include_watching`, `include_watchonly`) and RPCs affected, along with functional tests in rpc_deprecated.py and wallet_simulaterawtx.py.
evidence: "Since 'leet' commit 1337c72198a7d32935431d64e9e58c12f9003abc, the options are deprecated no-ops, so it seems time to properly start a deprecation cycle for them." (PR description)
problem: Legacy watch-only parameters remain accepted in multiple wallet RPCs despite having functioned as no-ops since an earlier commit. Callers can pass dead options without receiving deprecation warnings, delaying their eventual cleanup and removal.

risk.why: Clients still passing these legacy named parameters will receive an RPC error unless they configure the deprecation toggle or update their requests.

summary: Deprecates the unused watch-only named options across several wallet RPCs (`fundrawtransaction`, `walletcreatefundedpsbt`, `send`, `sendall`, and `simulaterawtransaction`). Passing `includeWatching`, `include_watching`, or `include_watchonly` now throws an `RPC_METHOD_DEPRECATED` error unless `-deprecatedrpc=watchonly` is enabled.
